patch_description: Prior gains (0.57→0.71) came from restart sweeps over diverse good basins. This edit (a) adds three structurally distinct seeds — a 9+4 two-cluster arc config, a reversed-chirality logarithmic spiral, and a perturbed 13-gon — and (b) rebalances the time budget: phase 1 sweeps all seeds within ~55% of the budget with hard per-seed truncation, then the remaining time alternates short strict re-anneal polish-kicks (sig=5e-3, ~0.25s each) around the top-2 basins found in phase 1, instead of over-polishing a single incumbent. The previous attempt failed due to an indentation mismatch in the SEARCH block; corrected here.
